description: Details submitted pursuant to reference 24/01301/FUL: construction management plan (8) in respect of redevelopment of site by the erection of  2 x 2-storey semi-detached dwelling houses together with new associated landscaping, cycle and  refuse storage.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
decision_conditions: The details submitted are insufficient to satisfy the discharge of construction management plan (8) of planning permission ref: 24/01301/FUL due to insufficient information pertaining to the submitted construction traffic management plan in relation to its swept path analysis and site logistic plan. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy CP24 of the Core Strategy, Policies T7 of the London Plan and Policy DMD49 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
